_comment: The Vana Personal Server's composed PDPP AS + RS.
Endpoints read from packages/server/src/pdpp-live-http-journey.test.ts on
vana-com/personal-server-ts @ waspflow/pdpp-integrated-journey-0917 (c1217fe),
which mounts the Resource Server on a real boot. Confirmation requested from
the integration lane; treat the values below as provisional until they reply.
Boot recipe: local/conformance-fleet-0917/handoff/LIVE-BOOT.md. It documents
the AS-only shape (config, VANA_MASTER_KEY_SIGNATURE, the scope-index row);
the composed branch also mounts the RS, so a grant to record read completes.
Unlike the reference implementation this deployment is CO-LOCATED (one origin,
one port), uses a session-based authorization journey rather than RFC 9126 PAR,
and exchanges an authorization code with PKCE. None of that is pinned by Core:
Section 6 defines the selection request and Section 7 the resolved grant, not
the route between them. The case bodies never see the difference.
foreignSubjectOwnerToken is deliberately absent: this deployment binds one
owner to the server, so RS-12 reports skip naming that rather than passing on
no evidence.
Open questions for the integration lane, tracked rather than guessed:
- is there an RFC 7662 introspection endpoint, advertised via RFC 8414
metadata, and does it require caller credentials?
- how are records seeded so the RS serves rows?
- are owner reads scoped by a query parameter, as the reference requires
connector_id? If so it is configuration here, not a finding.
Run: tsx src/cli.ts --target targets/vana-personal-server.json
